TrustSquare + Quick — human interface, end to end

24 Sep 2026 · a real browser on the live site as a stranger, a seller, a buyer and a Quick lister · QA accounts removed afterwards · live at the last deploy

Works · 10Was broken — fixed and read back live · 31Your decision today — acted on · 5Still open · 2

Listing (create & publish)

  • Listing Coach: a first-time seller's Publish was a dead end; it now opens the Terms step and goes live.
  • Phone numbers and emails in a private advert went live; they are now stripped on create, edit and Quick.
  • Only the first Listing Coach photo was kept; every photo is kept, and a held one is reported.
  • The hub kept showing 'Draft' after going live until a reload; it now takes the server's state.
  • Free plan stops at 2 live adverts (402 with an upgrade path).

Buying (browse, detail, search, intro)

  • Unverified seller: the app asked 'continue?' then the server refused; the buyer is now told plainly and the button says why.
  • Borderless adverts showed the viewer's city (Sydney reef read 'London'); they show their own city.
  • AI search 'fix my door lock' found nothing; it now relaxes word by word and finds Locksmith.
  • Detail views count again (the bug-sweep fix to the 422 view counter holds).
  • Intro accept → Tuppence burn → contact reveal not walked (you declined the QA Tuppence grant).

Selling & editing adverts

  • Every Services/Tutors edit failed with 422 (rate basis stripped); edits save, and the description's rate follows.
  • Edit form came back blank for Coach answers; they are read back from the advert.
  • Pause was a dead button; Pause and Resume work and hide/show the advert.
  • Delete asks twice and removes the advert.

Profiles

  • Seller profile and display name were saved only in the browser; they now save to the account.
  • The profile photo upload failed silently (CSP); it uploads.
  • Buyers now see the seller's headline, about and tags (never the name).
  • My Space showed '5 T' on an empty wallet; it shows 0.

Buzz

  • Nothing could create a Buzz connection; an employer's reference now connects the two.
  • Accepting Buzz silently accepted the whole Seller Terms; it now records Buzz only.
  • Terms tick gate, allow switch, one-line send with email fallback all work.

AI features

  • Coach showed a red 'Insufficient Tuppence' next to the free result; wording now says the free session is used.
  • AI Coach suggestions, AI search interpreter and trust action plan respond live.

Payments

  • Live Paystack confirm said 'test mode'; removed.
  • Wallet said R36, Paystack charged R33; the wallet now shows the live rate.
  • A cancelled checkout read 'contact support if charged'; it now says nothing was charged.
  • Checkout opens on the live Paystack page and a cancel leaves the balance untouched.

Complaints

  • Complaints were a mailto only; 'Report this listing' and 'Lodge a complaint' now file into the support queue with the advert named.
  • Upheld complaints had no writer; staff can now uphold one and it lands on the Trust Score.
  • Local Market seller no-show button not built: it cannot be proven without an accepted LM intro (needs Tuppence).

Country rules

  • Picker list is canon (your call); the FAQ now matches it and drops 'started in South Africa' (RUL-110).
  • EULA schedules for Botswana, Germany, Kenya, Mozambique, Namibia drafted as v1.19 for your review.
  • Trips and online services are borderless by your June/July rulings, and now labelled with their real city.

EULA

  • Buzz tick → one-tap live publishing without the Terms: closed.
  • Acceptance now records the version; people who accepted before v1.16 re-accept once at next Publish/Edit (your call).
  • Drafts do not expire: the 30-day sentence is removed in the v1.19 draft (your call).
  • v1.18 text is identical in the app, /terms and the source; the gate holds until both boxes are ticked; Back leaves the advert a draft.

Fade-out

  • Day 83 warning email, day 90 hidden, Keep live restores, 14 days later archived: all proven on a QA advert.
  • The 7-day warning now shows on the hub card with Keep live.
  • Archived cards no longer offer Edit/Share/Pause.

Removal for breaking rules

  • EULA 14.5 B3 (3+ ignored intros in 30 days) now blocks the seller's adverts automatically.
  • Staff can block (B1–B6) and reinstate from the server.
  • Drafts, archived and paused adverts are no longer readable by strangers by id.
  • A QA-bot fixture was on the public 'Today on the Square' strip; the showcase shows live adverts only.

Quick ↔ TrustSquare

  • Quick's link lands her signed in on her draft; publish opens the Terms; the advert goes live.
  • The app re-asked the email Quick already had; it is pre-filled.
  • Quick adverts could not be edited in the app (422); they can, and the rate sentence follows.
  • Trust duplicates: insurance and CIDB are one signal each at 6 / 4 (your call).
